latestVersion.changelog:
AI Animation Generator v1.0.0 initial release:

- Generate 1080p animated video clips from text prompts or images (PNG, JPG, MP4, GIF), up to 200MB.
- Automated connection to cloud GPU backend with free anonymous API access (100 credits/7 days).
- Session management, error handling, and status updates built-in.
- Exports video in MP4 and supports multiple formats (mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac).
- Supports prompt-driven video editing, aspect ratio control, overlays, and batch uploads.
- Clear timeline and workflow summaries provided for easy video editing.
